adversarialFindings.description: The real-JWT Commons read against the live provider is not yet observed; the browser journey uses a simulated provider.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Taken on this PR's Vercel preview, which builds the activated client against the live provider, before the owner authorizes the production merge. The production merge is held until that read returns ok; the hosted gate certifies the source only.

adversarialFindings.description: Without a build flag, the UI can only be removed by a reverted release.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The provider kill switch (removing the Hasura function permission) disables Commons within minutes; the entry then shows an unavailable notice and the original Guild keeps working. Documented in the provider README.

adversarialFindings.description: The code-point cap truncates on input, which can move the caret to the end when a paste overflows the limit.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Only text beyond the server limit is cut, the same outcome a native maxlength gives for BMP text.

retrospective.summary: Proceed to one hosted Final candidate; production merge only after the preview read and an explicit owner go-ahead.
